conditions.displayName: Two checker locations fail continuously for 3 minutes

documentation.content: Public HTTPS /healthz must return HTTP 200 and JSON status ok. At least two checker locations must fail continuously for three minutes. Check Worker, IAM origin forwarding, Cloud Run and Cloud SQL; no login is needed.

conditions.displayName: At least five 5xx in five minutes, sustained five minutes

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="retroboards" AND resource.labels.location="us-east4" AND metric.labels.response_code_class="5xx"

documentation.content: Five or more application 5xx responses in a rolling five-minute window, sustained for five minutes. Public uptime covers requests rejected before the container. Inspect error counts and service logs without copying member data.

displayName: RetroBoards: Cloud Run job execution failed

conditions.displayName: Any failed cron or monitoring job execution

documentation.content: A cron or monitoring execution failed. Inspect the named job. Manual overrides also count as failed executions; they never satisfy scheduled-success heartbeat checks.

conditions.displayName: No successful aggregate collector for 45 minutes

documentation.content: Fewer than one successful read-only collector snapshot in forty-five minutes, sustained for one minute; missing data also alerts. The collector runs every fifteen minutes. A zero-valued log counter does not satisfy this heartbeat. Check monitoring scheduler, collector identity and database connector.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="retroboards-monitor" AND jsonPayload.event="retroboards_monitor" AND jsonPayload.status="error"

documentation.content: Collector could not read aggregate database or Google job/backup metadata. Only its bounded stage is logged; no exception text or credentials are emitted.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="retroboards-monitor" AND jsonPayload.event="retroboards_monitor" AND jsonPayload.status="ok" AND jsonPayload.missed_schedule_count>0

documentation.content: A required scheduler-created successful execution is missing after thirty minutes of grace. Manual executions do not satisfy this check. Daily ticks before job creation are exempt; their next UTC scheduled tick is checked.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="retroboards-monitor" AND jsonPayload.event="retroboards_monitor" AND jsonPayload.status="ok" AND jsonPayload.due_count>0 AND jsonPayload.oldest_due_seconds>=1800

documentation.content: A queued email has remained due for thirty minutes. Age is measured from its current next_attempt_at (or creation when never attempted), so normal scheduled retry backoff does not trigger this alert. Probe reads counts and ages only.

displayName: RetroBoards: email transport or outbox failures

conditionMatchedLog.filter: (resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="retroboards-cron-5m" AND textPayload=~"Email outbox: .*retrying=[1-9][0-9]*|Email outbox: .*failed=[1-9][0-9]*|Email outbox: .*blocked_reason=(sender_unconfigured|domain_unverified)") OR (resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="retroboards-monitor" AND jsonPayload.event="retroboards_monitor" AND jsonPayload.status="ok" AND jsonPayload.failed_recent_count>0)

documentation.content: An email attempt needs retry, ended in terminal failure, or sending is blocked. Notifications are limited to one per hour. Probe terminal failure count covers the last twenty minutes; no addresses, subjects or error text are included.

displayName: RetroBoards: automated database backup failed or stale

conditions.displayName: automated database backup failed or stale

conditionMatchedLog.filter: (resource.type="cloudsql_database" AND resource.labels.database_id="rising-woods-449718-v6:imladris-boards" AND protoPayload.methodName="cloudsql.instances.automatedBackup" AND protoPayload.metadata.windowStatus=("STATUS_FAILED" OR "STATUS_SKIPPED")) OR (resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="retroboards-monitor" AND jsonPayload.event="retroboards_monitor" AND jsonPayload.status="ok" AND jsonPayload.automated_backup_stale=true)

documentation.content: An automated backup window ended failed/skipped, or the most recent successful AUTOMATED backup is older than thirty-six hours or absent. On-demand backups do not mask a broken automatic schedule. Retriable STATUS_ATTEMPT_FAILED events are excluded.
